summary_en: This phase 1 study tests a personalized cancer vaccine made of synthetic long peptides matched to each patient's cancer neoantigens, given with poly-ICLC. It is studied in muscle-invasive bladder cancer or upper tract urothelial carcinoma, gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma, melanoma, and non-small cell lung cancer, in patients with molecular residual disease. The vaccine is given as intramuscular injections on Days 1, 4, 8, 15, 29, 57, 85, 113, 141, and 169, co-administered with poly-ICLC by a trained healthcare provider. The study is designed to measure safety, feasibility, and immune response (immunogenicity).
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa una vacuna personalizada contra el cáncer, formada por péptidos sintéticos largos que coinciden con los neoantígenos tumorales de cada paciente, administrada junto con poly-ICLC. Se estudia en cáncer de vejiga músculo-invasivo o carcinoma urotelial del tracto superior, adenocarcinoma gastroesofágico, melanoma y cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas, en pacientes con enfermedad residual molecular. La vacuna se aplica como inyecciones intramusculares en los días 1, 4, 8, 15, 29, 57, 85, 113, 141 y 169, junto con poly-ICLC, administradas por un profesional de salud capacitado. El estudio está diseñado para medir la seguridad, la factibilidad y la respuesta inmunitaria.
who_for: Muscle-invasive bladder cancer or upper tract urothelial carcinoma with complete surgical resection (Cohort 1)
Stage II or III gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma with complete resection within 3 years (Cohort 2)
No residual disease or metastasis on conventional imaging
not_for: Known allergy or serious reaction to vaccines
Positive hepatitis B surface antigen or hepatitis C with active infection
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or receiving other investigational agents
